plain: Matthew Pines, a commentator on security and technology, says that in 2024 the physicist Leonard Susskind, a leading figure in string theory (an idea that the basic pieces of the universe are tiny vibrating strings), went on the podcast of a host named Kurt Jaimungal. Pines says Susskind, near the end of his career, called the theory a complete failure, basically pointless, and said everyone should start over. Pines found this shocking, since it would mean a major path in modern physics had come to a dead end.
